Author: Jake Koenig
Summary: Annual taxation has so many weird artifacts e.g. you save lifetime taxes by starting+ending your career in July or buying a house in January. Taxation should be continuous. Something like: 1. First 500k lifetime earnings tax free 2. Next million ~10% 3. Next million ~20% ... And…
